G-RC02/001EN
Dragon Deity of Destruction, Gyze
G Unit｜ Cray Elemental｜ Grade 4｜ Power 30000｜ Shield -
[AUTO]:When placed on (VC), choose five <Zeroth Dragon> from your bind zone, and call them to separate (RC).
[CONT](VC):You cannot ride nor call any rear-guards other than <Zeroth Dragon>. All of your units do not return to the G zone, and cannot be affected by anything other than this card and your guardians. Your rear-guards cannot be attacked.
[AUTO](VC):At the beginning of your turn, deal one damage to your opponent's vanguard for each <Zeroth Dragon> on your (RC).

G-RC02/001EN Neon Gyze side
Neon Gyze

[CONT]G zone:For your trigger effects, change the [Power] increase to "Choose up to one <Zeroth Dragon> from your G zone, and bind it face up".
[CONT]G zone:The <Zeroth Dragon> in your bind zone cannot move to other areas.
[Ultimate Stride]-"Dragon Deity of Destruction, Gyze"-Stride Step-[COST][Choose a card with the same card name as your vanguard from your hand, and discard it] Remove all of your other cards from your circles, soul, and G zone, flip this card over, and [Stride] it on your (VC).
